as_told.title: Konstantin Meyl's scalar waves and DNA resonance

plain: A scientist in Germany's Black Forest named Konstantin Meyl is said to be testing an extended version of electromagnetic theory on plants, using what he calls scalar waves, a proposed kind of wave beyond the standard theory, to "make flowers grow in beautiful ways." Michels brings it up himself on three episodes, once tying the idea to the physicists James Clerk Maxwell and Oliver Heaviside and once stressing scalar waves resonating with DNA; if it holds up, physics would have a hidden channel affecting living things.
